_meta.methodology: Immediate handoff assembled from existing sf-gym-web-research-a/b/c/e/f JSON files only. Included records that already had explicit public official pricing, high evidence quality, and an official source URL. Deduplicated by normalized name plus address, keeping the newest and richest record when duplicate research files disagreed. No new broad search, no aggregator pricing, no email, phone, account, password, or personal lead form was used.
limitations: This is a strongest-record handoff, not a complete fresh audit.
Official prices can change and may exclude taxes or conditional terms unless captured in notes.
Location-specific booking widgets that require personal contact data remain intentionally skipped.
